newsitem.title: USA: NRG sees Grays Ferry stake boosting EPS.
newsitem.headline: NRG sees Grays Ferry stake boosting EPS.

text.p: NRG Generating Inc said Thursday it expects its interest in the Grays Ferry Cogeneration Partnership to boost its 1998 earnings by $0.75 to $1.00 a share.
The Grays Ferry facility is expected to go into commercial operation in December 1997.
NRG on Thursday reported first quarter net income of $0.62 a share versus a year-ago loss of $1.33.
NRG said the earnings were above expectations, led by strong results in the Newark and Parlin cogeneration operations.

"Despite the warm winter and the resulting low level of dispatch revenues at Parlin, gross margins at both facilities were ahead of plan due to aggressive cost management in operations," chairman and chief executive Leonard Bluhm said in a statement.
NRG and its subsidiaries develop and own cogeneration projects which produce electricity and thermal energy.
